description: Tailwind CSS custom data to prevent false 'unknown at rule' warnings for @tailwind directives.

atRules.name: tailwind
atRules.description: Tailwind CSS directive that injects the base, components, or utilities styles (e.g. @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;).

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Injects Tailwind's base styles (preflight reset and element defaults).

atRules.name: apply
atRules.description: Tailwind CSS directive that inlines any custom CSS class (e.g. @apply bg-blue-500 text-white;).

parameters.name: classes
parameters.description: One or more Tailwind CSS class names separated by spaces.

atRules.name: variants
atRules.description: Tailwind CSS directive that generates variants for a set of utilities.

parameters.name: variants
parameters.description: Variant modifiers such as hover, focus, md:, etc.

atRules.name: screen
atRules.description: Tailwind CSS directive that creates a media block for a breakpoint (e.g. @screen md { ... }).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The breakpoint name defined in tailwind.config.js.

atRules.name: responsive
atRules.description: Tailwind CSS directive that generates responsive variants for utilities.
